utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch—I’m still looking for a few helpers. If you can lend a hand, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — that’d be wonderful! What time works best for you on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still in for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. Let me know what you need me to help with.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. If you can bring your basic tools and a steady hand, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help out this Saturday on the front porch—just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’d be so grateful. Could you come by at 10 a.m. on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, 10 a.m. to noon works for me. I’ll bring gloves and help keep things organized on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia. That works perfectly, and I’ll make sure the tools stay organized and the porch stays clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, I still owe you a hand. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be a huge help, Oren. Thank you—I'll be glad to have you there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I’d really appreciate a few helpers this Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone handy, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa — that means a lot. I’ll let a few neighbors know and I’m hoping we can get enough hands for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still in for Saturday on the front porch, Tess. Just tell me what job you want me on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — that’s a huge help! I’ll put you on greeting folks and sorting the easy fixes, and if you can, keep asking around for anyone handy too.
